name: LinkedIn Profile Analysis - Android Developer
description: Signals extracted from LinkedIn profiles to evidence Android Developer skills.

sections.notes: Look for specialization (e.g. 'Senior Android Engineer | Jetpack Compose | KMP').

sections.description: Work experience entries with job titles and project descriptions.
quality_indicators: Android-specific job titles (Android Engineer, Mobile Platform Architect, Android Lead)
Technologies described (Kotlin, Compose, Coroutines, Room, Hilt, KMP)
Scale and popularity of apps developed

signal_mapping.description: How LinkedIn mentions map to skill evidence using COMPOSITE KEYS ({skill_id}.{subskill_id}).

patterns.pattern: LinkedIn skills endorsement for 'Kotlin' or 'Android Development'
LinkedIn skills endorsement for 'Jetpack Compose' or 'Android UI'
Job experience describing building Jetpack Compose design systems and multi-module apps
Job experience describing Kotlin Coroutines, asynchronous Flow, and offline sync engines
Job experience describing Android CI/CD pipelines, Gradle build optimization, and R8 obfuscation

important_notes: ALL extracted signals MUST be mapped to COMPOSITE KEYS ({skill_id}.{subskill_id})
LinkedIn endorsements have low evidential value on their own; cross-validate with code
